batting.name: BJ Hodge
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b Bipul Sharma

batting.name: PA Patel
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b SJ Srivastava

batting.name: AC Gilchrist
batting.dismissal: c PA Patel b RP Singh

batting.name: KD Karthik
batting.dismissal: c DPMD Jayawardene b RP Singh

balls.text: direct hit from the straight boundary by David Hussey, what a throw, the full delivery had been swung down the ground, Hussey charged to his left from long on to save the boundary, not only that, he fired in the throw that caught Mahela well short
huge inside edge, but Gomez has to go, he stood back in the crease, looking to swing the length ball, got an inside edge on to pad, but the umpire thought there was no bat, gone
in the blockhole, Mahela had set himself up for the scoop over fine leg, but could not anything with it, gets it off the toe end through square leg
gets this one away off an inside edge towards fine leg
goes hard at a full ball outside off stump, gets an outside edge that flies to third man, it is Bhatt who decides to go for it, and it falls just short of him
low full toss on the pads, can't get it away past the man at deep midwicket
now he decides to try the agricultural, goes down on the knee and looks to reverse hit this one angling past him, misses completely,
106.9 kph slower ball, Mahela adjusts brilliantly, takes two steps down the track, and swings it inside out over extra cover, too much work for long off to do, he can't get there
short on the leg stump, tucks it towards midwicket for a single
Mahela stands in the crease and guides the full delivery with a neat turn of the wrists, but short third man is there
gone first ball! low dipping full toss around off stump, PArthiv tries to chip it over the bowler, bat turns in his hand, and short extra cover takes a simple chance as it loops in the air to him

slower one short from round the stump, he looks to bash it over the bowler, but gets it down to long off, they decide to come back for the second, the throw is at the right end, Owais is miles short of the crease as Gill takes off the bails, well, looked like the only way he would have got out today, both batsmen gestured that they could not hear the call amid the noise
Mahela misses this one, fired in full outside off, he goes down on the knee looking to loft it but cannot connect
backs away again and lofts the full ball inside out over the off side, on the bounce to sweeper cover
can't get this one away, as he looks to go hard at it
smoked! vanishes over long on, full toss on middle, Owais is backing away and unfurling a huge swing of the arms to murder it over the boundary
gets an inside edge as he charges down the track, short fine leg fields
now he shuffles and looks to swing it over square leg but cannot connect for once
tossed up wide outside off as he sees the batsman making room outside leg, just seemed to be inside the tramline but given wide
now plays the most delicate of late dabs but it goes straight to short third man
Mahela, what a shot, makes room outside leg and caresses a full ball inside out through point, beat that, pure class
tries to repeat the shot, this one pitches full and he scythes it wide of long off
crunch! Owais hurries down the track hungrily, also makes room outside leg, takes it on the full and bashes it over the straight boundary
another wide full down the leg side, Gilly's horror day in that region continues, short fine leg tidies up
stands two feet outside leg stump before the ball has been bowled, he fires it full and he swings it away down towards long on
low full toss on the pads, Mahela cannot get it away, lofts it on the bounce to long on
yorker on middle stump, Mahela is hardly worried, digs it out towards point as calmly as possible
now he flows in to the square drive, where had he been hiding, sweeper cover has to do a lot of work to get there in time
slightly short, Owais is ready, lets it come on and uses the wrists to swing it backward of square leg
swung over midwicket, Owais takes it from around off stump, and swings it with the wrists for a couple
goes back to push a length ball with a straight bat on the off side
flicked off the pads with typical Mahela flourish, he was gone if the throw from midwicket had hit
full delivery around off stump, drive elegantly along the ground to long off
Hodge departs, he again came down the track, it was fired in on leg stump, he looked to loft it over midwicket, but hit it straight to Marsh who came in from the boundary to take the dolly
comes down the track, looking for the big swing, gets an inside edge that goes fine on the leg side, Bipul has his hands on his head
full ball around middle stump, driven away to long off
turning away from off stump, punched away to sweeper cover
full toss outside off, he waits for a moment, before punching it hard but it goes to sweeper cover
tucked away through midwicket for a single to retain the strike
bowled slowly again, at least makes the batsman ponder for an instant, cut away to point
tossed up slowly, and he gets something out of the wicket, but he does this rarely, gets an outside edge as he comes forward and it goes past the keeper
driven towards extra cover where some neat fielding saves some runs
gets behind the line of this one outside off to push to point

gone this time, something for Piyush, another wrong 'un, he went for the sweep, but was struck on the pads, umpire gave him out right away, would that have missed off stump as it was sliding across Jadeja? he is gone now though, replays show it would have just missed off
low full toss outside off, Mahela makes further room to guide it past point, but cannot beat the man there, Jadeja would have been gone, had Bhatt collected the throw cleanly, chance missed
full and wide outside off, he cracks it back to the bowler, who can't field it cleanly and concedes a single
very full delivery, almost in the blockhole, worked away from leg stump through midwicket
fuller and slower this time around off stump, driven down to long on
this one goes straight on from outside off stump, he adjusts to push to point
swept away off the pads for short fine leg to make a tumbling stop
another wrong 'un, shortish, flat and turning away from the left-hander, played out on the off side
tossed up ball draws him forward and he pushes it down the track
shortish and turning away, slapped off the back foot to sweeper cover
Mahela gets to 50 with a crunching blow over extra cover, stays in the crease and lofts the full delivery with the turn over the boundary
97.7 kph, too quick to do anything, flatter one pushed away in front of covers
gets him to come forward and push at one tossed up a touch slowly, and he gets it in the air but well past the bowler to long off
back of a length ball angled in to the batsman who pushes it back to the bowler
drives this full ball hard to extra cover, it goes too quickly to him and Mahela has to rush back
116.2 kph slower ball from back of a length, he adjusts and waits for it to arrive, and cuts it to sweeper cover
short ball banged in, he gets on top of it and pulls it away to deep midwicket

third man has no chance with these outside edges on this belter of a pitch and this fast outfield, Jadeja looks to force it from close to the body, the ball flies off the edge to beat a diving third man who was not far from it
tries to tuck him off the pads but misses, Mahela wants the single but is sent back as Shalabh gets to the ball quickly
this one angles across Jadeja, he goes on the back foot to punch towards covers
deft goes Mahela, dabs it late but cannot beat short third man
tossed up, pushed off the front foot to extra cover
dropped at slip, it is Valthaty, it was pushed through quicker, he got an edge that went low to Paul at slip and he clanged it
here comes Jadeja, and crashes Piyush miles over the long on boundary,

Piyush has a wicket, or does he, low full toss dipping on Jadeja, who goes at it, gets an inside edge on to boot, or ground, that will be the question, and Gilly takes it, but replays show it is off the ground
gets off the mark with a single towards midwicket
pushed away in to the leg side off the front foot

he's gone this time, McCullum isn't impressed, he went for another sweep, missed, got hit on the back leg and was given out, did it pitch outside leg, was there some inside edge, didn't look like, finally  Punjab have a wicket
connects with the sweep and long leg runs across to cut it off with a dive
goes for the sweep to one fired in flat on the pads but can't connect
shot! Mahela with minimum of effort, gets a flighted one in the slot, takes a step out and lofts it over extra cover for a boundary
short and again sliding down leg with the angle, he hardly bowls two leg breaks in a row, turned round the corner to short fine leg
pushed back down the track off the front foot
another one goes past Gilly, his bowlers are giving him a hard time, Piyush fired it flat and fast down leg, keeps low and beats Gilly
short and wide outside off, but bounces a bit and he adjusts to cut it to sweeper cover
goes back to a short of a length ball turning away and punches to sweeper cover
skids and slides a flat ball wide down leg
strikes Mahela on the pads as he attempts to sweep, not given, was that going down leg
turning away from around middle, gets a thick edge towards point as he comes forward
pushes it away down the ground towards long off for a single
Punjab continue to leak runs, short from Harris, Baz is ready, lets it come on and pulls it in front of and over deep square leg
clatter! Baz connects with this charge down the track, gets width as wel, and swings it high over wide long off in to the crowd
hurries on to him from a length, he gets forward and gets an inside edge back to the bowler
gets on top of the bounce on this short of a length ball and drops it in front of point
and tucks him up with a length ball on middle and off and it is defended with a straight bat
gets forward to push a length ball towards mid off who hits the stumps but Mahela has made it
crack! this time he does, another one wide outside off, Mahela goes hard at it, and crashes it past covers in the air
can't get it away through the off side in field again, it was there to be smacked, short and wide outside off, Mahela reached out but could not time it
tucked away through midwicket for a single
yikes, Shalabh does not like this one bit, shortish on leg stump, and Baz swings it with good timing, Bhargav makes a mess of it at short fine leg
third time Gilly is tested with a screamer down the leg side, and this time it is too much for him, pitched outside leg and moved further down the leg side,
looks to make room and crash this back of a length ball through covers, but cannot time it past the infield

flatter one sliding on the pads, he goes down for the sweep and gets it past Shalabh at short fine leg, the ball is flying on this outfield, small and fast, bad for the fielders, he tries to pull it back with a dive, and just about manages to
Mahela takes off, gets a full flighted ball, takes a step out and creams it over long on
flicks this fullish ball away in front of square leg
tossed up this time around off stump, and pushed down the track
darted in on the pads, ticked away to a pretty short short fine leg
skips down the pitch and looks to loft him down the ground, gets an inside edge the goes behind square leg
this outfield is quite small, Mahela gets an outside edge as he tries to drive a full ball and third man has to quickly get to his left to cut it off
no fuss defence from Mahela, calmly lets the length ball arrive and smothers it in front of extra cover
again he comes down the track, looking to flat-bat it over deep mid off, but mistimes it on the bounce to that man
loses his line this time, pitched back of a length and goes wide down leg
here comes Baz, abandoning all niceties, having a mighty go at one three pace down the track, but misses as it is too close to him
stays in the crease, allows this one to come on outside off and guides it to third man with an open face
angled across the right-hander off a length, pushed away towards covers
angled in from wide of the crease, he gets an inside edge as he pushes at it
class from Mahela, takes it from off stump, goes down on a knee and sweeps it past short fine leg
tossed up outside off, he gives it everything and it flies to the man at long off
decides that this one has to vanish, and it does, gets to the pitch, and swats it dismissively wide of long on, beating the man at deep midwicket
tossed up and going straight on, comes forward to take it on the pad
pushed away off the back foot to covers
turned off the pads towards short fine leg
almost casually, Mahela takes on the flighted ball, and goes for the lofted shot, it did not turn, and he got a bit of an edge but enough to beat mid on
gets the single this time working the ball to deep midwicket
gets bat in front of pad and tucks this one away towards square leg
tossed up outside off and pushed back to the bowler
gets this one around middle and leg, and Baz gets a leading edge down the track
and bowls it wide down leg first up
ripper to end an erratic over, pitches outside off, Mahela pokes forward and the ball zips past, there is lots of carry on this surface,
he manages to bowl it outside off stump, and gets it to straighten on Mahela who keeps it down with soft hands as it flies wide of the lone slip
elegance from Mahela, Harris continues to bowl it on the pads, MAhela gets front leg across and flicks to give squarish long leg no chance
another one on the leg side, he tickles it off his pads, and long leg manages to pull it back in
Gilly is getting the working over, again he flies to his left horizontally to parry one that threatens to zip past him wide down leg, Harris yet to find his radar
phew, that has gone flying, Gilly goes airborne to his left, and stops four wides as HArris sprays it very wide down leg
hello, Baz charges down the pitch second ball, this one is angled in to him, he gets an inside edge on to pad as he is cramped for room
some away shape for HArris from a good length around off, he comes forward and pushes to covers
clatter! all over, Punjab are alive, Hussey makes room outside leg, takes two steps out, gets under a full delivery and that is sailing over the sightscreen
runs in and fires the fuller delivery that goes between Hussey's legs as he moves about in the crease
that'll help, it is Hussey with the boundary, shuffles and flicks a length ball high over midwicket,
excellent yorker from Sreesanth, he gets the legs out of the way, and manages to get bat down to jam it away on the leg side
bowls a high full toss that a surprised batsman pats down the track, Sree cannot stop it and concedes the single
slightly short and he latches on in a flash, pulling it in to the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Hussey can't connect with the flick but takes the run as the ball rolls away on the off side
gets the single down the ground to long off
again Mandeep goes through the off side, more work for the man at sweeper cover
hit away for a single through midwicket
its the flying Baz again, cut hard off the front foot, he appears out of nowhere at point to save the boundary with the big dive and even finds time to fire in the throw at the non-striker's
more confident driving from Mandeep, full ball slammed away to sweeper cover
Mandeep is playing this shot really well, length ball outside off and he crashes it past point off the front foot
the sling from Vinay after stopping in the delivery stride, but it is sliding down leg
heaved away down the ground to long on for a single
slower one, comes on after ages, he waits an eternity before cutting straight to point, has to hurry back as the throw comes in
shot! don't move, that is headed for the wide long off boundary, pitched full and he drives it in the gap past extra cover, crucial boundary
he comes forward and crunches a full ball off the front foot, goes in the air again to sweeper cover
Jadeja saves the run with a diving stop to his left as hussey drives weakly down the track, excellent over
rushes down the track and flashes this one wide of sweeper cover in the air
gets forward and works it away to deep midwicket
strikes him on the pads with the fuller one, there is a shout, but that is going down leg
worked away in front of midwicket, there is no one there, but they are getting only one as Jadeja goes charging after the ball
tossed up ball and he drives it for the single to long off

RP is doing it here, another one, there is no stopping him today, Marsh goes for the drive off the full delivery, the bat closes in his hands, and the ball loops back to RP, nothing is getting past him
Baz is turning it on in the field, hit hard past the bowler, but McCullum hurls himself on the ball from mid on
misses the flick off the full ball fired in on the pads, but they scamper through for the run as the ball goes to midwicket
RP finds some movement even now, bowled full and he beats the batsman on the drive as the ball zips away from the bat
hangs back in the crease to steer this one coming in to third man, it travels to the man at the speed of light

gone! RP cannot do anything wrong today, strikes right away, excellent catch at extra cover, it is that man Mahela, the perfect leap, it was driven over his head off the front foot, but he timed his leap to take the screamer, Dinesh is gone
Karthik keeps the strike with a single, its down to almost run a ball, who would have thought, massive

super effort at sweeper cover, it was crunched off the front foot, Baz goes flying to his left to parry it off the ropes, the ball rolls away from him, but Sree coming in from long off cannot get there in time
misfield at point, cut hard off the back foot and bursts through point's hands, when it rains ...
Marsh tries the stand-and-deliver approach, cannot connect though as he looks to swing it over midwicket
bosh! Karthik comes forward and hammers this full ball off the front foot, sweeper cover somehow manages to stop the grenade
everything going Punjab's way, outside edge on the big drive off a full and wide ball, on the bounce in to the third man boundary
Dinesh will keep the strike with a flick in front of square leg
now makes him come forward and beats him on the drive with one that goes straight on
misses out on the cut this time as he bowls it flat and quick outside off
Jadeja serves up another full toss, on the pads, gifts galore, Dinesh accepts it, swinging it over cow corner
Dinesh gets to 50 with a furious swips that sends the ball miles in to the crowd over deep midwicket, charges down the track ,takes it on the full, fetch that
fired in flat and quick and he works it away to deep midwicket, whoops, there is an overthrow as well, Kochi are in a mess right now
one more, Dinesh is running away with this, striking at 200 now, gets the reverse sweep in the air and comfortably wide of short third man
he is absolutely creaming them, as if he has a point to prove, goes down on the knee and slog-sweeps it over deep square leg
gets the single this time to bring Dinesh on strike
tough chance missed, Marsh takes two steps out and slogs it over cow corner, Sreesanth in the deep cannot time his leap right enough and the ball goes over him
Dinesh is in a tearing hurry, rushes down the track and hammers this short one past midwicket but there is another man in the deep
shortish, sitting up, but MArsh pulls it right to deep midwicket, kept a bit low that one
gets away with this one, full ball outside off, he gets to the pitch and pushes away to extra cover
low full toss angled across Marsh who misses out, crashes it straight to sweeper cover
full but lots of width outside off and he opens the face to drive it along the ground wide of sweeper cover
floated up in the blockhole at 120.8 kph, Dinesh respectfully pats it back o the bowler
another one, short again, this time outside off, so Dinesh goes over midwicket, pulls hard and collects four more
poor ball first up, short, down the leg side, short fine leg is in the circle, Dinesh reads all those hints and pulls it over that man in circle
Marsh goes big, he looks in supreme touch, gets under a full delivery and hammers it over the sightscreen, big golf swing and it does the job
slam! Marsh gets width, Marsh connects with the slapped drive on the up, and beats long off in to the boundary
short delivery outside off, cut away to point
whippy delivery at 136.6 kph, full outside off stump, and Marsh is beaten on the drive
bangs this in short and wide outside off and it moves away further to be called a wide
one hand come off the bat handle as Dinesh stretches forward to reach this full one dragged across him, and gets it wide of sweeper cover
looks to force a length ball going across him but gets it off the bottom edge to the bowler
connects this time but can't get it away past point
beats him outside off with one bowled on a length from round the stumps
eased away by MArsh with an open face, but Jadeja with a diving stop at backward point saves the boundary
now he gets adventurous, takes his eyes off, bends the knee and goes for the scoop over fine leg, getting it high but can;t time it well enough
does not matter to Karthik, he hangs in the crease, gets on top of this one and crunches it to the deep point boundary
Dinesh charges down the track, and crashes this short of a length ball with the angle high over deep midwicket, that was absolutely belted
very full ball, almost in the blockhole, and MArsh eases it back to Hodge
Karthik goes for the agricultural slog sweep, has to reach out to drag it from off stump to deep midwicket
gets the single through midwicket as he gets a thick inside edge this time
Marsh plays a perfectly placed cut, short and wide, but as someone says they have to be put away, and MArsh delayed the shot for a moment to get it wide of sweeper cover
tossed up in to the pads and defended down the track
goes down for the reverse paddle as the full ball arrives and gets it fine past the keeper, short third man with the diving stop
Vinay continues to lurk in the corridor outside off and beats Marsh with one that slowly angles across him
stands in the crease and works it from around off stump towards midwicket
superb ball from Vinay at 137.5 kph, making Dinesh come forward and rushing past his outside edge close to off stump, Vinay thinks there is an edge on that, could have been pad
goes for the drive off a length ball outside off to Hodge at extra cover
whoops, Karthik would have been gone had he missed this one, he had shuffled across, and took it off his pads at the last moment and flicked it away wide of long leg
short of a length on the stumps and worked away on the leg side
brings bat in front of the front foot that he had plonked a long way forward, ad works it away in front of midwicket
short of a length this time and MArsh arrests the front foot movement, goes back and opens the face to guide it behind point
makes no difference, serves up a wide full toss that Marsh eases past point, and on this outfield, third man has zero chance
again Marsh comes forward and just lofts through the line of the ball, and it disappears over the man at mid off,
tries to cut one going wide across him outside off, and is beaten
Marsh comes forward and drives through the line of the ball, opens the face as well, and he must have timed it superbly as it flies over covers
super from Karthik, shuffles across and whips it wristily in the gap to the right of mid on who tries to cut it off but it is too quick for him
driven confidently off the front foot to mid off

that's the end of Gilly, tame end really, stands in the crease and looks to hoick the back of a length ball over midwicket, gets a thick edge that flies high to PArthiv who happily gobbles it, RP's night just got better
Gilly is struggling, full ball angled in almost in the blockhole, he looks to flick it away and it goes through his legs
gives him the charge and RP fires it in, rolls away behind point and MArsh has to hurry back before the throw hits the stumps
full delivery shaping away, he adjusts to open the face and guide it to point
goes for the swinging yorker, ends up as a low full toss around off stump, he tries to work it away but gets an inside edge towards mid on
goes full and fast down the leg side looking to bend the ball full and back in to the batsman, but it goes awry and the keeper manages to parry it away with a dive
hits this short of a length ball in to the ground as he looks to force it through the off side
two men in the circle at point, Gilly cracks it off the back foot, beats one of them, but the other one backs up superbly with a diving stop, six runs saved in two balls
good work from Parameswaran at mid off, runs across and cuts off a sweet punch from Marsh that would have otherwise raced to the straight boundary
inward shape in to Gilly's pads, he adjusts to work it towards mid on for a single
crashed off the middle of the bat but straight to extra cover on the edge of the circle
Marsh comes forward slowly, allowing for it to move away from a fuller length and pats it back to RP

and goes through Valthaty with a full ball that is angled in, he goes for a drive from the crease again, and the ball crashes in to middle stump through the big gap between bat and pad, brushes the pad on its way to flattening middle stump, RP is pumped up
goes for this one wide outside off stump from the crease, no foot movement and he is beaten
another one, RP pitches short on leg stump, and Valthaty goes hard at it, swivelling and pulling for a flat six in front of deep square leg
driven towards the covers this time
smashed over midwicket, camps in the crease, and lifts this one which is not short enough off the front foot and high in to the first tier over deep midwicket
shot, stands tall, adjusts for the away movement and pings it past extra cover, but not hard enough to beat mid off who gets across to field
goes hard at a fuller one from the crease, no footwork, just looking to slam it over the bowler, and gets an inside edge towards mid on
Sree goes up in appeal again, but this full delivery was going down leg even as it struck him on the pads
hangs deep in the crease, lets the length ball come on the pads, and flicks it wide of the man at short fine leg
stays on the back foot to a length ball and pushes it back to the bowler

gets it to shape in to the left-hander from a length, he gets bat in front of pad to work it away towards midwicket, Sree thought that was pad first, and appealed initially before realising he was wrong
worked away with the angle in front of midwicket
here goes Gilly, this one angles in on the pads, and he picks it up over midwicket, beating the man in the deep
straightens close to off stump at 142.6 kph, he lets it go this time
looks to swing him over mid on, but ends up missing it again as the ball moves away outside off
lovely delivery, draws Gilly out for the drive, and shapes away late to beat the outside edge
another wide, they are having a field day, the extras, RP goes down the leg side again
pushed towards covers off the back foot as he moves it away a touch from outside off
it is the day of wides, RP starts with down the leg side from a length
